gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-nag-mund: Press Start 2P is all pinned-apart, retro fun up top. Noto Sans Nag Mundari is the quieter sans-serif below, with lowercase that rivals the capitals and curves that look half unwrapped.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-nushu: Pixel-bright and playful, Press Start 2P spaces its letters like cut-outs pinned far apart. And Noto Sans Nushu follows with a towering x-height, so a long stretch of text feels tall and modern.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-ogham: Playful, with Press Start 2P pinning its letters far apart. Noto Sans Ogham sits below with wide gaps in the e and tall bodies, so the heading's toy-like spacing and the body's bold-looking lowercase give the page two distinct voices.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-ol-chiki: Playful and retro, Press Start 2P leads. Noto Sans Ol Chiki holds its curve tails well back, so words form solid blocks, and that tidy, compact texture is the quality that stands out most.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-old-ital: Press Start 2P spaces its letters like cut-outs pinned far apart, with big open-looking lowercase bowls. Noto Sans Old Italic takes over below, a sans-serif with almost no gap between x-height and cap height, so the page feels dense under that airy heading.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-old-nort: Noto Sans Old North Arabian packs a dense, tall lowercase band with terminals flaring outward like tongs. Under Press Start 2P, a long read stays compact.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-old-perm: Press Start 2P brings the retro fun. Noto Sans Old Permic answers with rounded, open-sided forms and lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, so the page feels playful above and approachable below.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-old-pers: Press Start 2P puts its pinned-apart, cut-out letters up front. And Noto Sans Old Persian, with lofty lowercase and open counters, can be sized modestly since its tall body stays easy to take in.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-old-sogd: Retro and cheeky, with cut-out spacing. Press Start 2P hands off to Noto Sans Old Sogdian, a sans-serif whose tall x-height and wide-mouthed letters stay crisp, so extended text flows cleanly and approachably.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-osage: Chunky fun, retro through and through. Press Start 2P leads, while Noto Sans Osage fills lines with inflated lowercase bowls and sweeping open curves, so a modest body size would likely hold up well.
